instruction: Rename the directory "todo_list_Jan_1" on the Desktop to "todo_list_Jan_3".

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

result.command: [ -d ~/Desktop/todo_list_Jan_1 ] && echo 'Directory exists.' || echo 'Directory does not exist.'

metadata.explanation: Task requires renaming directory from todo_list_Jan_1 to todo_list_Jan_3. Evaluator verifies that the OLD directory (todo_list_Jan_1) no longer exists after rename operation.

llm_judge_reasons: Incomplete coverage: evaluator only checks that old directory (todo_list_Jan_1) no longer exists
Missing verification: does not check that new directory (todo_list_Jan_3) actually exists
False positive risk: would incorrectly pass if directory was deleted instead of renamed
A complete rename verification requires checking both: (1) source no longer exists AND (2) destination exists
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add a second evaluator check to verify that ~/Desktop/todo_list_Jan_3 exists after the rename operation
Or modify the command to check both conditions: verify old directory doesn't exist AND new directory exists
Example compound check: '[ ! -d ~/Desktop/todo_list_Jan_1 ] && [ -d ~/Desktop/todo_list_Jan_3 ] && echo "Rename successful" || echo "Rename failed"'
